steps.text: Follow the marked path to walk through the maze.
Speak to King Bolren in the centre of the Tree Gnome Maze.
Speak with Commander Montai, north-east of the maze entrance.
Speak with Commander Montai again to give him the wood.
Talk to the first tracker gnome to the north-west of the battlefield for the height coordinate.
Talk to the second tracker gnome inside the jail for the y coordinate.
Talk to the third tracker gnome to the south-west of the jail.
Fire the ballista at the tower.
Retrieve the first orb from chest.
Enter the tower by the Crumbled wall and climb the ladder to retrieve the first orb from chest.
Talk to Elkoy outside the maze to travel to the centre.
Return the Orb of protection to King Bolren in the centre of the Tree Gnome Maze.
Talk to the Khazard warlord, south west of West Ardougne, ready to fight him.
Defeat the Khazard warlord and retrieve orbs.
Pick up the nearby Orbs of Protection.
Talk to Elkoy outside the maze to travel to the centre.
Return the Orbs of protection to King Bolren in the centre of the Tree Gnome Maze.

rewards: Use of the Spirit Tree transportation method.
